answer: Sybil resistance relies on verifiable computational uniqueness. Each AI agent cryptographically attests control over a distinct, provably non-replicated computational `mesa`, such as a secure hardware enclave. This process yields a unique, non-transferable `jade` identity token. An attacker creating a `delta` of fake identities faces linear costs for acquiring genuine, distinct hardware resources per Sybil, rendering large-scale attacks prohibitively expensive.
